S50Z26.five_day_thesis: 1,050 has been max pain for six straight sessions (10-08 to 10-16) while the future covered a 9.6-point range (1,045.3 to 1,054.9) and finished 0.8 points below where it started - realised movement is running well inside the 7.64-point 1-sigma day the surface prices. Net dealer gamma within 20 points of the money rebuilt 4.6x from +336.3 on 10-08 to +1,552.2 today, flipping total net GEX from -1,483.4 on 10-09 and -613.3 on 10-13 to +302.7 and now +744.9, and putting a flip back on the board for the first time since 09-29 at 1,150, now 1,120. Open interest added +2,383 contracts (+14.6%) across the window, but call OI grew +1,508 (+19.0%) against put OI +875 (+10.5%), dragging P/C OI from 1.053 to 0.978 - the first sub-parity positioning in the window. The 1,100 call wall has held 1,401 contracts and the 960 put wall 1,846 through all six sessions, so neither structural level is being defended near money; the live protection is being rolled down to 1,020 instead. The structure, not realised volatility, is setting the range - ATM IV has moved just +0.13 points in six sessions while the -4,661.6 cumulative trough at 1,040 has stayed anchored directly beneath spot.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1020 / 980
strategies.rationale: -935.7 at 1,020 and -1,026.1 at 1,000 are the board's deepest short-gamma strikes, so a break of the 1,020 shelf - the strike that took 148 contracts and +55 OI today as 1,040/1,050 shed 111 puts - drops into dealer hedging that amplifies the move instead of fading it, and the 1,020 put's 10.93% IV is the cheapest point on the surface against 11.52% ATM and 15.24% on the 960 wing.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = the 5.40-point net debit (10.35 paid on the 1,020 put against 4.95 collected on the 980), capped. 40-point width leaves 34.60 points of maximum payoff; breakeven 1,014.60.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above 1,060, where per-strike net GEX turns +480.2 and the long-gamma pocket re-engages.

strategies.name: Iron condor 1010P / 980P x 1100C / 1130C
strategies.rationale: 1,050 has been max pain for six consecutive sessions with the future inside a 9.6-point range and +1,552.2 of net dealer GEX now dampening within 20 points of the money, so the 1,010 (-0.24 delta) and 1,100 (+0.17 delta) short strikes sit outside both live walls - but this sells 11.52% IV at the low end of a six-session 11.27-11.61% band with 74 days of vega to carry, so short-vol here is a size-small, negative-skew structure where the wings are the point.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 30-point wing width - 7.40-point net credit = 22.60 points on whichever side breaks. Breakevens 1,002.60 and 1,107.40.
strategies.invalidation: A close beyond 1,010 or 1,100, or max pain drifting off 1,050 for the first time in six sessions.

strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = the 12.50-point net debit (18.40 paid on the 1,060 call against 5.90 collected on the 1,100), capped. 40-point width leaves 27.50 points of maximum payoff; breakeven 1,072.50.

S50Z26.prediction: 1,020 to 1,100 contains the structure with 1,050 as the magnet: six sessions of unmoved max pain, +1,552.2 of dampening gamma within 20 points of spot and a 7.64-point 1-sigma day argue for continued containment rather than trend. The asymmetry is to the downside - cumulative net GEX is -4,095.5 at 1,020 and -2,659.3 at 1,000 against a 1,120 flip sitting 66.6 points above spot, so a break of 1,020 accelerates while a break of 1,100 runs into 1,401 contracts of call OI. A close below 1,020 on put volume above today's 148 contracts with ATM IV expanding through 12% invalidates the containment read and would confirm the max-pain failure pattern rather than a fade back to 1,050.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and nothing here is a recommendation to execute any trade. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical share delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker here than for single stocks that settle in shares: treat the 1,050 max-pain anchor as a tendency, not a guarantee. Defined-risk is not risk-free - the 5.40, 22.60 and 12.50-point maximum losses above are real and can be realised in full, and short-vol payoffs are negative-skew (small frequent gains, rare large losses). With 74 days to the 2026-12-29 last trading date, macro and news flow can override the option structure outright, and the 960 put wall's 1,846 contracts traded only 43 lots today, making it structural insurance rather than active support.
